theme: Pricing so the good risks do not leave
title: Renewal Repricing Against the Pool That Remains
strategies: trivial: freeze every tier's price at last cycle's value (zero rate change)

greedy cost-plus: fit each tier's blended CURRENT-pool expected loss from the loss histograms, add a flat underwriting margin, clip to the rate-change-cap band -- prices the pool you have today and never asks who stays

strong post-selection search: for each tier, exactly simulate the elasticity-driven departure of every risk bucket at each candidate price inside the cap band, score the REALIZED profit of the surviving pool, and take the tier's true argmax -- tiers are independent under the cap so this per-tier reformulation is exact
invalid: quote a price far outside the rate-change-cap band
